sources.title: Best AI for SQL Generation 2026: 30 Models Benchmarked
sources.snippet: Which AI model is best for SQL generation? We benchmarked 30 models on complex SQL — joins, window functions, recursive CTEs, cohort analysis, and temporal queries. GPT-5.6 Terra led at 94%, but 13 models scored above 85%. Full results.

sources.title: ai_gen function | Databricks on AWS
sources.snippet: The ai_gen () function invokes a state-of-the-art AI model to answer the user-provided prompt using SQL. This function uses a chat model serving endpoint made available by Databricks Foundation Model APIs.
